web-guide-idea-46.audience: Local shop owners taking their first practical step online.
web-guide-idea-46.offer: Guide one concrete setup, such as a digital menu or product catalogue. Keep the scope small enough to complete and understand.
web-guide-idea-46.steps.0: Choose the shop’s most useful starting point.
web-guide-idea-46.steps.1: Organise a few products with clear photos and descriptions.
web-guide-idea-46.steps.2: Show the owner how to update the result themselves.
web-guide-idea-46.equipment: A camera phone, product details and good light. Some account administration may be easier on a laptop.
web-guide-idea-46.returnReason: Offer a later session on adding seasonal products or improving photos, rather than taking permanent control of the account.
web-guide-idea-46.promotion: Use a sample menu to demonstrate the deliverable. Let owners enter their own passwords and verification codes.
